examples.question: What did each region bring in?
examples.gold: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC
examples.predicted: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(*) AS brings FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY brings DESC
